question: Why is word valid cognition here?
premises: word non-different from śiva-natured reflective awareness
word illuminates self and other by clarity
valid cognition is nothing but consciousness-essence reflective awareness
inference: word is valid cognition because it is non-different from reflective awareness
plain_english: Thus the word, non-different from reflective awareness whose nature is Śiva, illuminates self and other here by clarity; valid cognition is indeed nothing but reflective awareness whose essence is consciousness, and other things are so only by figurative application.
